approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Email addresses inside current body text or quoted history currently create false compact RFI or Submittal references.
Reject address suffixes in the shared normalizer and clean complete addresses only when reference text contains an at sign, retaining later real identifiers.
Reuse the existing deterministic extractor and regular-expression module; add no dependency, mailbox access, semantic inference or model call.
Offline parser and API regressions, specification sync and every bounded task context pack passed before completion.
title: Ignore workflow-like email address tokens
objective: Prevent complete email-address tokens in any supported source from creating false RFI or Submittal relationship groups without weakening real exact references.
